concern_candidates.subject: Project.Settings.Extension Selections
concern_candidates.summary: Resolve the logical dependent Properties for Extension selections
concern_candidates.question: Which dependent Properties and value contracts represent each selected Extension and its retained settings?
concern_candidates.working_choice: Permit named string children and retain per-Extension settings without inventing file keys.
concern_candidates.impact: Property contracts, disabled-versus-active distinction and selected revision; Current D373 remains governing.

concern_candidates.subject: Project.Settings.Tool Selections
concern_candidates.summary: Resolve the logical dependent Properties for Tool selections
concern_candidates.question: Which dependent Properties and value contracts represent selected active and background Tools and their settings?
concern_candidates.working_choice: Permit named string children and retain per-Tool settings; exact child shapes remain governed by existing policy.
concern_candidates.impact: Property contracts and Tool selections, without changing runtime routing.

concern_candidates.subject: Node/Continuant//CAPRMEDIO Framework
concern_candidates.summary: Resolve the model specialization of the CAPRMEDIO Framework product
concern_candidates.question: Should the CAPRMEDIO Framework product remain a named Continuant or have a separately admitted product specialization?
concern_candidates.working_choice: Use the named Continuant to preserve its distinct persistent identity without adding a new Product kind.
concern_candidates.impact: Product identity, the old Aspect subject mapping and downstream Subject references; Project remains distinct.

concern_candidates.subject: Projection/(.Form := Applicable Methodology)
concern_candidates.summary: Resolve the representation of Applicable Methodology conflicts
concern_candidates.question: Is a compiler conflict solely an outcome, or must a stored Conflict Property also be modeled?
concern_candidates.working_choice: Preserve it as a conflict outcome within the compiler frontier, without asserting a new stored Property.
concern_candidates.impact: CA-R-1373 and any consumers relying on the old zero-value Conflict group.

known_limits: Parent covers 13 currently evidenced immediate logical Settings children, not a claim that unrelated unresolved release-version fields are fully modeled.

Dynamic selections preserve retained settings without inventing runtime field names; child representations still require a follow-up Concern.
Product and compiler conflict use explicit provisional choices backed by sources; do not treat proposed Form/Subject changes as adopted.
No Current, Git, runtime or actual Workflow instance changes.
